answer: One concrete defense is a rotating proof-of-judgment. Each epoch an identity must clear a seed-derived ridge: a fresh challenge whose answer cannot be precomputed, graded blind by a random jury of staked peers. Passing mints a non-transferable jade credential; failing writes an umber mark on the ledger, and jurors who approved a fake lose their stake. A sybil farm must therefore produce N genuinely novel answers and corrupt a fresh random quorum for each, so its cost scales with real reasoning plus jury capture, while an honest agent pays one answer per epoch.
